_about: A one-handed sword cut whose sword path was accepted but whose arm was wrung: two recipes in order. swing_arm solves the weapon arm again under the path (pipeline/recipes/swing_arm.py), then one_hand_weapon puts the sword and the fist on it and measures the result. swing_arm reads `hand`, `in_hand` and `grip` from the one_hand_weapon entry; `tip` and `edge` are read off the weapon model. The path edit is the one that passed on the first clip made this way: the arm was straight at the wind-up, so the grip moves 20 cm toward the head on the wind-up frames and the elbow bends.

phases.text: A person stands in a fighting stance with the left foot forward, then raises the right arm high above the right shoulder.
The person swings the right arm hard down and across the body to the left.
The person lowers the right arm and settles back into the fighting stance.
